overview.description: The Janus Henderson AA-A CLO ETF (JA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in AA- to A-rated collateralized loan obligations (CLOs). The fund seeks capital preservation and current income through diversified exposure to higher-quality CLO tranches. JA was launched on Feb 18, 2026 and is issued by Janus Henderson.
